ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass via Windows Firewall Snap-In Hijack
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects attempts to bypass User Account Control (UAC) by hijacking the Microsoft Management Console (MMC) Windows Firewall snap-in

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\mmc\\\.exe$") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*WF\\\.msc.*")) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\WerFault\\\.exe$"))
